comments.text:
Create a ParamRegistry module in crates/integral-core/src/param_registry.rs that provides structured metadata for every editable parameter in the INTEGRA-7 mixer/routing state.

PURPOSE: Both the React web app and the future Vizia VST UI need to know: parameter name, min/max/default, display format, logical group, and SysEx address. Currently this is duplicated in TypeScript components (SynthKnob label, min, max) and Rust address constants. The registry centralizes it.

DATA MODEL:
- ParamDef struct with: id (e.g. part.1.level), name, group, min, max, default, format (Raw / SignedCenter / Named / Custom), address builder function
- ParamFormat enum for display formatting

SCOPE (Phase 1 — mixer params only):
- Per-part (x16): level, pan, mute, chorus_send, reverb_send, output_assign, receive_channel
- Master: level
- Ext: level, mute
- Chorus: enabled, type, level, output_select
- Reverb: enabled, type, level, output_assign
- Solo part

IMPLEMENTATION:
- New file: crates/integral-core/src/param_registry.rs
- Add pub mod param_registry to lib.rs
- Provide pub fn mixer_params() -> &'static [ParamDef]
- Unit tests verifying total count, specific param lookups, format output
- Run just check to verify

REFERENCE FILES:
- crates/integral-core/src/params.rs (address constants)
- crates/integral-core/src/state/mod.rs (PartState, MixerState defaults)
- web/src/types.ts (TypeScript PartState interface)
- web/src/ChannelStrip.tsx (hardcoded min/max/default examples)

title: Core: add ParamRegistry with metadata for all mixer parameters
